serviceName: Kastana website and booking page on your own domain
description: Points your own domain at your Kastana website and booking page. Adds two records: one that proves the domain is yours, and one that sends visitors to your shop. Use it without a host to connect the whole domain (the www address).
variableDescription: verify is the one-off value that proves the domain belongs to the shop (letters and numbers, made by Kastana for each domain).
